product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides cloud-based, AI-enabled practice-management software for dental practices, connecting clinical care, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments, and patient engagement in one platform.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage directly describes Curve Dental as an AI-powered cloud-based dental practice-management platform connecting the listed clinical and administrative functions.

pricing_page.notes: The cited Curve Dental pricing page discusses special pricing and directs customers to request details, establishing a public pricing page even though prices are not listed.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company case study identifies Dental Choice as a Curve customer; Curve’s pricing page testimonial identifies Emerson Dental. | named_customers.0: The case study explicitly identifies Dental Choice as a practice using Curve. | named_customers.1: The pricing page testimonial identifies Emerson Dental as a Curve customer.

employee_band.notes: Curve Dental’s LinkedIn company profile lists its company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The contact page labels the Alpharetta address as Curve Dental’s Corporate Headquarters, establishing Alpharetta as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The contact page labels the Alpharetta, Georgia address as Corporate Headquarters and gives the country as USA.

founded_year.notes: Curve Dental’s About page explicitly says it was founded in 2004.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes general educational content and lists primarily dental-practice advice and product-oriented articles; it does not show the required two engineer-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: Curve’s public Help Center links to several article categories, including quick guides, new releases, FAQs, and troubleshooting/technical articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Curve Dental careers posting is titled AI/ML Software Developer and says Curve is looking for an AI Software Developer.

model_provider.value: Pearl AI for dental X-ray diagnostics, Bola AI for voice charting, and Mango AI via Mango Voice for call summaries.
model_provider.notes: Curve Dental’s AI product page identifies Mango AI/Mango Voice for call summaries, Bola AI for voice charting, and Pearl AI for X-ray diagnostics; it does not identify a specific underlying general-purpose LLM.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Curve Dental’s data policy names SOC 2 compliance and ISO 27001 certification; its homepage says its infrastructure is HIPAA-compliant. The requested list names these publicly stated compliance standards. | compliance_certs.0: Curve’s data policy explicitly names SOC 2 compliance. | compliance_certs.1: Curve’s data policy explicitly identifies its information-security management system as ISO 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.2: Curve’s homepage states that its infrastructure and security controls are HIPAA-compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history labels the February 2018 Battery Ventures round as a growth investment. | funding_date: The funding profile states the latest funding round was dated February 8, 2018, yielding YYYY-MM 2018-02.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent recorded round was the Battery Ventures investment announced in February 2018, well before the 18-month window preceding November 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Curve Dental careers page lists openings across Development, Implementation, and Sales; its only Sales title is Product Specialist, with no SDR, BDR, or Account Executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve Dental announced Curve Memberships on September 3, 2026, a new product feature within the six-month window before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Curve Dental announced on September 29, 2026 that Rick Hansen was appointed Chief Customer Officer, within the prior 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Curve Dental Customer Account Executive job posting explicitly names Salesforce and Gong as the systems used to track prospects and sales activity. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The job posting explicitly names Gong.
